about: The route eval of the ask box (AT-17), from decision 09 of .scratch/front-door/. A question with source 'real' is one the commissioner asked. A question with source 'claude' is written by Claude. Expect is topic:<key>, team:<name>, free_answer, miss, refuse, or judgment. A judgment question has no fixed route and is not in the count. The questions ran on week 8 of the 2026 season. A question with turns asks after those earlier turns of its Thread, oldest first (H18). A comparison of the asker's team with one named team goes to the free answer (H28). Each question of the main set runs with `pages`, the pages of CPC in week 8. The `site` set holds the 40 questions of decision 01 of .scratch/site-answer/: 22 site questions and 18 traps, on week 10 with the pages of CPC in week 10. A site question expects site:<key>, site:all, or site:missing, and site:all|site:missing takes either. A trap expects its old route and passes when it does not route to the site.
